args: SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'mod_DarkStar_Mk2_Pack_SpaceTrucker_Backpack_Quality_%' ORDER BY EditorID

SELECT f.FormKey, edid(f.Base) base, f.Parent, edid(f.Parent) cell, f.HasScripts FROM Forms f WHERE f.Base IN (SELECT FormKey FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND EditorID LIKE '%Unique%') OR f.Base IN ('006F43:cryomancer_z.esm','0164DC:cryomancer_z.esm','009172:cryomancer_z.esm','01599D:cryomancer_z.esm','01650C:cryomancer_z.esm')
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID FROM Forms WHERE EditorID LIKE '%CodexMachine%' OR EditorID LIKE '%CodexMach%' ORDER BY Signature
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, Name FROM Records WHERE Signature='WeaponModification' AND (EditorID LIKE 'lmod_Legendary_Wep_3_%' OR EditorID LIKE 'lmod_Legendary_Weap_03_%') ORDER BY EditorID
SELECT EditorID, substr(FormKey,1,6) id FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('Loot_Display_WeaponsCase_Pistols_Common','Loot_Storage_LC102_GuestOutfit')

SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('ResMfg_DarkStar_QuantumRig_Workbench','ResMfg_DarkStar_LegendaryMatrix','ResMfg_DarkStar_Codex__Blank','cat_Category_Outpost_DarkStar','rp_DarkStar_Legendary_Armor_Mod','rp_DarkStar_Legendary_Weapon_Mod')

SELECT Signature, TotalCount, Cached FROM SignatureCounts WHERE Signature IN ('Activator','CombatStyle','GameSettingFloat','GameSettingUInt','BodyPartData','AimModel','GameplayOption','GameplayOptionsGroup','DefaultObject','ActorValueModulation','PlacedObject','PlacedNpc','GenericBaseForm') ORDER BY Signature

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.MajorFlags') mf, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.Race')) race FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND (EditorID LIKE 'Skin_%' OR EditorID LIKE 'Clothes_Cryo_Robotics%') ORDER BY mf
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, json_array_length(Data,'`$.Items') n, edid(json_extract(Data,'`$.AddToList')) anam, json_extract(Data,'`$.AddToList') a FROM Records WHERE Signature='FormList' ORDER BY anam

SELECT Signature, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(EditorID) AS first_edid, MAX(EditorID) AS last_edid FROM Forms WHERE Signature IN ('GenericBaseForm','GameplayOption','GameplayOptionsGroup','CombatStyle','AimModel','Activator','BodyPartData','ActorValueModulation','SnapTemplate','PackIn','Static','MoveableStatic','LayeredMaterialSwap','PlacedNpc','DefaultObject','Light','LocationReferenceType') GROUP BY Signature ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS recordsWithScripts, group_concat(DISTINCT json_extract(s.value,'$.Name')) AS scripts FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.VirtualMachineAdapter.Scripts') s
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, Name FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('DSM_Mk3_Rocketlauncher','DSM_Mk3_Bridger','DSM_Mk3_Lawgiver','DSM_Mk3_Kodama','DSM_Mk3_Magstorm')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Records WHERE Signature='MiscItem' AND Data LIKE '%scaling:WeaponConfigurator%'

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword') WB, json_extract(Data,'$.Conditions') IS NOT NULL C FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND EditorID LIKE '%ForceAssault%Quality%'
SELECT substr(FormKey, instr(FormKey,':')+1, instr(FormKey,' ')-instr(FormKey,':')-1) AS Plugin, IsOverride, COUNT(*) AS N FROM Forms GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT FormKey, EditorID, IsOverride, json_extract(Data,'$.TargetOmodKeywords') T, (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(p.value,'$.Record'),' ') FROM json_each(Data,'$.Properties') p WHERE json_extract(p.value,'$.Property')='Keyword') K FROM Records WHERE Signature='WeaponModification' AND EditorID LIKE 'amod_DarkStar_Weap_%Quality%' ORDER BY EditorID
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.TargetOmodKeywords') tok FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'NFVC0003_mod_Nova_Nightingale_Mag_%'
SELECT EditorID, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject')) co FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND Data LIKE '%ComparisonValue__:__2000__,%' LIMIT 3
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Forms WHERE EditorID='PlayerUnityTimesEntered'
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.RecipeFilters') F FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND EditorID LIKE 'co_DarkStar_Weap_Melee_CryoP79%'
SELECT EditorID, IsOverride, json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') AS bMin, json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') AS bMax FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND EditorID LIKE '%Ecliptic%'
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID, Name FROM Forms WHERE EditorID LIKE '%Rejuv%'
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID FROM Forms WHERE Signature='Terminal'
SELECT substr(FormKey,1,6) ID, Signature, EditorID FROM Records WHERE substr(FormKey,1,6) IN ('0004AF','0004AD','0004F4','0004FD')

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.ArmorRating') ar, json_extract(Data,'$.Value') val, substr(json_extract(Data,'$.Armatures'),1,90) arma FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('Spacesuit_Cryo_01_1','Spacesuit_Cryo_08_1','Spacesuit_Cryo_12_1','Spacesuit_Cryo_30_1','Spacesuit_Cryo_H_01_01','Spacesuit_Cryo_H_30_01','Spacesuit_CryoMiner_Backpack_01','Spacesuit_CryoMiner_Backpack_30','Clothes_Cryo_RoboticsSuit_02','Clothes_Cryo_RoboticsSuit_03','Clothes_Cryo_RoboticsSuit_04','Clothes_Cryo_Robotics_Hat_01','Clothes_Cryo_Robotics_Hat_02')

SELECT r.EditorID, t.key, en(json_extract(t.value,'`$.Name')) nm, (SELECT group_concat(edid(i.value ->> 'Mod'),' ') FROM json_each(t.value,'`$.Includes') i) inc, (SELECT group_concat(edid(k.value),' ') FROM json_each(t.value,'`$.Keywords') k) kw FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'`$.ObjectTemplates') t WHERE r.EditorID IN ('DarkStar_Mk2_Pack_SFTA06_Int01_Assault','DarkStar_Mk2_Apparel_SFTA06_TrackSuit_01')
SELECT EditorID, FormKey FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('RifleXPLProjectile','ShotgunXPLProjectile','PistolBulletProjectile_ExplosiveImpact_Damage01','WeaponTypePistol','WeaponTypeShotgun')

SELECT Signature, TotalCount, OverrideCount, Cached FROM SignatureCounts WHERE Signature IN ('Projectile','Explosion','Ammunition','Weapon','Hazard','Spell','ObjectEffect','MagicEffect','WeaponModification')

SELECT Signature, json_extract(Data,'$.MajorFlags') mf, json_extract(Data,'$.Flags') fl, COUNT(*) n, MIN(EditorID) ex, MAX(EditorID) ex2 FROM Records WHERE Signature IN ('Weapon','Armor') AND IsOverride=0 GROUP BY 1,2,3
SELECT json_valid(Data) ok, length(Data) len, substr(Data,1,3000) head FROM Records WHERE FormKey='049B54:Starfield.esm'
SELECT json_group_array(k.key) FROM (SELECT Data FROM Records WHERE EditorID='SFTER_MQ03_Combat_A_TerranArmada_Scipio02_AutopilotAI') r, json_each(r.Data) k

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(Data,'$.TargetOmodKeywords[0]')) AS guns_with_df_mags FROM Records WHERE Signature='WeaponModification' AND IsOverride=0 AND json_extract(Data,'$.AttachPoint') = '05D4D7:Starfield.esm'

SELECT EditorID, Name, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.OverrideProjectile')) AS proj, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.AmmoType')) AS ammo FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND IsOverride=0 AND (EditorID LIKE '%Mk3%' OR EditorID LIKE '%MkIII%') AND (EditorID LIKE '%Rocket%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Bridger%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Launcher%' OR Name LIKE '%Negotiator%' OR Name LIKE '%Bridger%' OR Name LIKE '%Microgun%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Microgun%')

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Flags') AS Flags, json_extract(Data,'$.CrimeValues') AS Crime FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('kgcShip_FACT_CrimeStardock','kgcShip_FACT_Stardock','kgcShip_FACT_Watchtower_Hostile')
SELECT r.FormKey, r.EditorID, f.c FROM Records r JOIN (SELECT ToFormKey k, COUNT(*) c FROM Refs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3) f ON f.k=r.FormKey
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, Signature FROM Records WHERE EditorID='SFTA05_AddInto_DefaultLegendaryWeapons'

SELECT i.EditorID, i.Name, (SELECT group_concat(r.FromEditorID) FROM Refs r WHERE r.ToFormKey=i.FormKey AND r.FromSignature='MiscItem') datums FROM Records i WHERE i.Signature IN ('Weapon','Armor') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Refs r WHERE r.ToFormKey=i.FormKey AND r.FromSignature='MiscItem')<>1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS weapons, SUM(json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') = '0, 0, 0' AND json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') = '0, 0, 0') AS zero FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND IsOverride=0 AND json_extract(Data,'$.IsJunk') = 0
SELECT FormKey,Signature,EditorID FROM Forms WHERE FormKey='003042:darkstar.esm'
SELECT EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND EditorID LIKE '%Neuroamp%'
SELECT r.EditorID, json_extract(e.value,'$.Level') lvl, edid(json_extract(e.value,'$.Reference')) ref FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.Entries') e WHERE r.EditorID='LCharSpacer'
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, length(Data) FROM Records WHERE Signature='Perk' AND EditorID LIKE '%Explos%'
SELECT EditorID, Name FROM Records WHERE Signature='Quest' LIMIT 5
SELECT FormKey FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND EditorID LIKE 'co_qmod_Weap_ForceAssault_Blade_Quality_0%' ORDER BY EditorID
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND EditorID IN ('Lawgiver','Kodama','Grendel','Coachman')

SELECT EditorID, Data ->> '$.FirstPersonFlags' f, Data ->> '$.Keywords' k, Data ->> '$.AttachParentSlots' a FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('thh_Darkstar_Mk2_Accessory_BH_M2_Gear_BeltStraps','thh_Darkstar_Mk2_Accessory_BH_M2_Gear_Device')

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword') WB FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND json_extract(Data,'$.AmountProduced')=0 AND json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject') IN (SELECT FormKey FROM Records WHERE Signature IN ('WeaponModification','ArmorModification')) LIMIT 6

SELECT edid(ToFormKey) AS target, COUNT(*) AS refs, group_concat(DISTINCT FromSignature) AS from_types FROM Refs WHERE lower(ToFormKey) LIKE '%:sfbgs003.esm' OR lower(ToFormKey) LIKE '%:sfbgs00d.esm' GROUP BY ToFormKey ORDER BY refs DESC

SELECT Signature, COUNT(*) n, MIN(length(Data)) minLen, MAX(length(Data)) maxLen, (SELECT group_concat(key, ' ') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT j.key FROM Records r2, json_each(r2.Data) j WHERE r2.Signature = r.Signature AND j.key NOT IN ('Record Header','EDID - Editor ID','Signature') LIMIT 8)) AS someFields FROM Records r WHERE Signature IN ('Activator','CombatStyle','BodyPartData','AimModel','GameplayOption','GameplayOptionsGroup','DefaultObject','ActorValueModulation','PlacedObject','PlacedNpc') GROUP BY Signature
SELECT Signature, TotalCount, Cached FROM SignatureCounts WHERE Signature IN ('Projectile','Explosion','Ammunition','Hazard','MagicEffect','ObjectEffect')
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Properties') P FROM Records WHERE Signature='WeaponModification' AND EditorID='mod_DarkStar_Mk3_Weapon_CombatKnife_Quality_7'

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Description') AS D FROM Records WHERE Signature='Perk' AND (EditorID LIKE 'Skill_Incapacitation%' OR EditorID LIKE 'Skill_ShotgunCertification%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Incapacitation_Rank%' OR EditorID LIKE '%ShotgunCertification_Rank%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Records r WHERE r.Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND tier(edid(json_extract(r.Data,'$.CreatedObject'))) BETWEEN 2 AND 8

SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('BountyHunterFaction','GroupFactionCrimsonFleet','EclipticFaction','GroupFactionEcliptic','EclipticFriendFaction','FreestarRangerFaction','TheFirstFaction','RobotFaction','SpacerFaction','GroupFactionSpacers','StarbornEncounterFaction','GroupFactionStarborn','LC165StarbornEnemyFaction','LC165StarbornAllyFaction','UnitedColoniesMarineFaction','UCSysDefFaction','UCVanguardFaction','VaruunFaction','GroupFactionVaruun','CurrentCompanionFaction','CurrentCrewFaction','CurrentFollowerFaction','AvailableCrewFaction','PotentialCrewFaction','AvailableCompanionFaction','PlayerAllyFaction','GuardFaction','ShipServicesFaction','CaptiveFaction','SecurityGuardClass','ActorTypeHuman','HumanRace','PlayerFaction') ORDER BY Signature, EditorID

SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('dtEnergy','dtElectromagnetic','dtPhysical','Stim_dt_piercing','Stim_dt_freezing','Stim_dt_structural','ap_gun_Mag','AmmoLaser','AmmoLaserSmall','AmmoLaserCutter','AmmoParticleFuseHeavy','AmmoParticleFuseLight','AmmoShotshell','AmmoShotshellCLL','AmmoShotgun','Ammo40mmXPL','AmmoRivet','ma_CanHaveNullMuzzle','ma_Beowulf','ma_Equinox','ma_Regulator','ma_Maelstrom','ma_InflictorPistol','ma_Cutter','ma_Novalight','ma_AutoRivet','ma_Bridger','ma_RocketLauncher','ma_Novablast','ma_Sidestar','ma_ArcWelder') ORDER BY Signature, EditorID

SELECT FormKey, EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Type') AS Type FROM Records WHERE Signature='Keyword' AND (EditorID LIKE 'Anim%' AND (EditorID LIKE '%Knife%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Sword%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Melee%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Axe%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Blade%' OR EditorID LIKE '%2H%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Hammer%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Polearm%') OR EditorID IN ('WeaponTypeMelee1H','WeaponTypeMelee2H','WeaponTypeUnarmed'))
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Items') FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('fl_DarkStar_Cryomancer_Apparel_BaseSet')
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Conditions') C, json_extract(Data,'$.ConstructableComponents') K FROM Records WHERE EditorID='co_avm_DarkStar_Weap_Skin_HellersCutter'

SELECT r.EditorID, json_extract(p.value,'$.Name') N, coalesce(json_extract(p.value,'$.Object'), json_extract(p.value,'$.Data')) V FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.VirtualMachineAdapter.Scripts[0].Properties') p WHERE r.EditorID IN ('EquipDatum_DarkStar_Mk2_Weapon_Orion','EquipDatum_DarkStar_Mk2_Spacesuit_Navigator_Body') AND (json_extract(p.value,'$.Name') LIKE 'Quality5%' OR json_extract(p.value,'$.Name') LIKE 'Quality6%')

SELECT json_extract(Data,'$.Archetype') AS kind, SUM(json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') = '0, 0, 0' AND json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') = '0, 0, 0') AS zeroBounds, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND IsOverride=0 AND EditorID LIKE 'DarkStar_Mk2_%' GROUP BY kind
SELECT r.EditorID, COUNT(*) AS Links FROM Refs f JOIN Records r ON r.FormKey=f.FromFormKey WHERE f.ToFormKey='00239C:darkstar.esm' AND f.FromSignature='PackIn' GROUP BY r.EditorID ORDER BY r.EditorID
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID, IsOverride FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE '%Beam%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Reciever%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Receiver%' ORDER BY Signature, EditorID
SELECT EditorID, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject')) co FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND instr(Data,'"ComparisonValue":"2000"')>0 LIMIT 3
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Keywords') K, json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectTemplates[0].Includes') I FROM Records WHERE EditorID='DarkStar_Mk2_Apparel_bhz_BH_j01'
SELECT Signature, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE '%Mk3_scx%' OR EditorID LIKE 'co_DarkStar_Mk3_%'

SELECT json_extract(p.value,'$.Name') N, json_extract(p.value,'$.Object') V FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.VirtualMachineAdapter.Scripts[0].Properties') p WHERE r.EditorID='EquipDatum_DarkStar_Mk2_Pack_Explorer_01_Landmark' AND (json_extract(p.value,'$.Name') IN ('WeaponOrArmor','Quality1File','Quality8File','MythicOmod'))

SELECT r.EditorID, j.key AS i, edid(json_extract(j.value,'$.Mod')) AS mod, json_extract(j.value,'$.MinimumLevel') AS lvl FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.Includes') j WHERE r.EditorID LIKE '%Mk3%TiersAny%'
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='ActorValueInformation' AND FormKey LIKE '000310%'
SELECT json_extract(Data,'$.VirtualMachineAdapter.Scripts[0].Name') n, json_extract(Data,'$.VirtualMachineAdapter.Scripts[0].Properties') p FROM Records WHERE EditorID='Quest_Nomad'
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Forms WHERE Signature='FormList' AND EditorID LIKE '%Injectable%Legendar%'
SELECT EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND json_extract(Data,'$.AmountProduced')=0 AND EditorID LIKE '%Quality%' LIMIT 5
SELECT Value FROM Meta WHERE Key='SourceStamp'

SELECT r.EditorID, t.key, en(json_extract(t.value,'`$.Name')) nm, (SELECT group_concat(edid(i.value ->> 'Mod'),' ') FROM json_each(t.value,'`$.Includes') i) FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'`$.ObjectTemplates') t WHERE r.EditorID IN ('cry_Darkstar_Mk2_CryoBreach','cry_Darkstar_Mk3_CryoBreach','cry_DarkStar_Mk3_CryoAA79','cry_Darkstar_Mk2_CryoArc79') AND t.key>0
SELECT Signature, EditorID FROM Forms WHERE EditorID LIKE '%NeuroBoost01%'
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Data') FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE '%ModGear%'

SELECT SUM(EditorID LIKE 'SMS%' OR EditorID LIKE 'SMC%' OR EditorID LIKE 'SMX%') parts, SUM(NOT (EditorID LIKE 'SMS%' OR EditorID LIKE 'SMC%' OR EditorID LIKE 'SMX%')) other FROM Forms WHERE Signature='GenericBaseForm' AND IsOverride=0

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.UseTemplateActors') AS UTA, json_extract(Data,'$.Aggression') AS Aggr, json_extract(Data,'$.TemplateActors.AiDataTemplate') AS AiTpl FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('ASELvlGenesisNoAggro','ASELvlGenesis','ASEGenesisOfficer','ASEGenesisMendoriBoss')
SELECT EditorID, FormKey FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'lmod_Legendary%' AND (EditorID LIKE '%\_4\_%' ESCAPE '\' OR EditorID LIKE '%None%' OR EditorID LIKE '%Blank%') ORDER BY EditorID
SELECT p.value FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.Properties') p WHERE r.EditorID = 'mod_DarkStar_Mk2_Apparel_Quality_9' AND p.value LIKE '%000310%'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Records) recs, (SELECT Value FROM Meta WHERE Key='CachedRecordCount') meta_cached, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Records WHERE Signature='Explosion') expl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon') weap, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Refs) refs

SELECT substr(EditorID,1,instr(substr(EditorID,13),'_')+11) cls, Data ->> '$.FirstPersonFlags' f, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(Data,'$.Keywords') k WHERE k.value LIKE '23C7C0:%')) body, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(Data,'$.Keywords') k WHERE k.value LIKE '23C7C1:%')) helm, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(Data,'$.Keywords') k WHERE k.value LIKE '23C7BF:%')) pack, SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(Data,'$.AttachParentSlots') k WHERE k.value LIKE '022821:%')) lining, SUM(json_array_length(Data,'$.Components')>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(Data,'$.Components') c WHERE json_type(c.value,'$.QualityMods') IS NOT NULL)) qm, COUNT(*) n FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND EditorID LIKE 'DarkStar_Mk2_%' GROUP BY 1,2
select FromSignature, count(*) n from Refs group by FromSignature order by n desc limit 14
SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(EditorID) ex, MAX(EditorID) ex2 FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND Data LIKE '%ComparisonValue__:__2000__,%'

SELECT r.EditorID, edid(json_extract(r.Data,'$.CreatedObject')) creates, edid(json_extract(r.Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword')) bench FROM Records r WHERE r.Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND edid(json_extract(r.Data,'$.CreatedObject')) LIKE '%Codex%' AND edid(json_extract(r.Data,'$.CreatedObject')) NOT LIKE '%Codex_kgc%'
SELECT EditorID, Data ->> '$.Keywords' k FROM Records WHERE EditorID = 'DarkStar_Mk2_ASESpacesuit_Ecliptic'
SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(c.value,'$.Data.Reference') ref FROM Records r, json_each(r.Data,'$.Conditions') c WHERE r.Signature='ConstructibleObject' LIMIT 5
SELECT json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject') CO FROM Records WHERE EditorID='co_mod_Backpack_Slot01_Oxygen'
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'mod_Beowulf_Modgroup%' OR EditorID IN ('mod_Beowulf_Mag_Standard','mod_Beowulf_Mag_ArmorPiercing')
SELECT Signature, COUNT(*) n, SUM(Parent IS NOT NULL) withCell, SUM(HasScripts) scripted FROM Forms WHERE Signature IN ('PlacedObject','PlacedNpc') GROUP BY Signature
SELECT r.FromSignature, r.FromEditorID, r.Path, edid(r.ToFormKey) fl FROM Refs r JOIN Records i ON i.FormKey=r.ToFormKey AND i.Signature='FormList'
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.CrimeFaction') AS CF FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('kgcShip_NPC_LvlSecurity_Stardock','kgcShip_NPC_EncWatchtower01Template')
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'llw_DarkStar_Ammo_Vile%'
SELECT r.Path, r.ToFormKey, f.EditorID FROM Refs r LEFT JOIN Forms f ON f.FormKey=r.ToFormKey WHERE r.FromFormKey IN ('27DF97:Starfield.esm','27DF96:Starfield.esm')

SELECT IsOverride, edid(json_extract(Data,'`$.InstantiationFilterKeyword')) ifk, edid(json_extract(Data,'`$.WorkbenchKeyword')) wb, json_extract(Data,'`$.CreatedObject') LIKE '%darkstarpatch%' AS createsMk, COUNT(*), MIN(EditorID) FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT r.FromSignature, r.FromEditorID, COUNT(*) FROM Refs r JOIN Records i ON i.FormKey=r.ToFormKey AND i.Signature IN ('Weapon','Armor') WHERE r.FromSignature IN ('Quest','Book','Terminal','TerminalMenu','Message','Activator','Furniture','Perk','Spell') GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT EditorID, edid(json_extract(Data,'`$.AmmoType')) FROM Records WHERE Signature='Weapon' AND json_extract(Data,'`$.AmmoType') LIKE '0003E7%'
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID, Name FROM Records WHERE Signature IN ('Weapon','Armor') ORDER BY Signature, EditorID

SELECT json_extract(Data,'$.Archetype') AS kind, SUM(json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.First') = '0, 0, 0' AND json_extract(Data,'$.ObjectBounds.Second') = '0, 0, 0') AS zero, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND IsOverride=0 AND json_extract(Data,'$.IsJunk') = 0 GROUP BY kind
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE EditorID LIKE 'mod_DarkStar_Mk2_Pack_Explorer_01_Landmark_Quality_%' ORDER BY EditorID

SELECT FromSignature, FromEditorID, Path FROM Refs WHERE ToFormKey IN (SELECT FormKey FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('NFVC0003_Spacesuit_Vigilance_Security_SetC_FieldEngineer','NFVC0003_Spacesuit_Helmet_Vigilance_Security_SetC_FieldEngineer'))
SELECT EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND EditorID LIKE 'co_qmod_Weap_%_Quality_2' LIMIT 1
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Flags') AS Flags FROM Records WHERE EditorID IN ('ASE2EverbrightCrimeFaction','ASE2FrostFaction')
SELECT Name, json_extract(Data,'$.Name') FROM Records WHERE EditorID='Spacesuit_Ecliptic_Helmet'
SELECT FormKey, EditorID FROM Records WHERE Signature='Perk'
SELECT FormKey, EditorID, Name FROM Records WHERE Signature='Armor' AND EditorID LIKE 'Spacesuit_%' AND Name LIKE '%Spacesuit%' LIMIT 3
SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.Data') AS value FROM Records WHERE Signature LIKE 'GameSetting%' LIMIT 6
SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(EditorID) ex, MAX(EditorID) ex2 FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND instr(Data,'"ComparisonValue":"2000"')>0
SELECT f.FormKey, edid(f.Base) AS base, f.Parent, edid(f.Parent) AS cell, f.HasScripts FROM Forms f WHERE f.Base IN ('001D2F:darkstar.esm','009B53:darkstar.esm')
SELECT FormKey, Signature, EditorID, IsOverride FROM Forms WHERE EditorID IN ('DarkStar_Mk2_Accessory_bhz_BH_12','DarkStar_Mk2_Apparel_bhz_BH_j09')
SELECT EditorID FROM Forms WHERE Signature IN ('GameplayOption','GameplayOptionsGroup')

SELECT edid(json_extract(Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword')) wb, CASE WHEN en(json_extract(Data,'$.Description')) IS NULL OR en(json_extract(Data,'$.Description'))='' THEN 'empty' ELSE 'name' END d, COUNT(*), MIN(EditorID), MAX(EditorID) FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND edid(json_extract(Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword')) IN ('wb_DarkStar_WeaponCrafting','wb_DarkStar_ArmorCrafting','wb_DarkStar_ApparelCrafting') GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT Signature, EditorID, FormKey FROM Forms WHERE (Signature='Cell' AND EditorID='CityNewAtlantisLodge') OR (Signature IN ('Static','Location','Package','Scene') AND rowid % 50000 = 7) LIMIT 8
SELECT FormKey, Signature, IsOverride FROM Records WHERE EditorID='SFTA05_AddInto_DefaultLegendaryWeapons'
SELECT EditorID, edid(json_extract(Data,'$.AddToList')) anam, json_extract(Data,'$.AddToList') a, substr(Data,1,200) FROM Records WHERE Signature='FormList'

SELECT r.FromSignature, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ToFormKey) items, MIN(r.FromEditorID) ex, MIN(r.Path) path FROM Refs r JOIN Records i ON i.FormKey=r.ToFormKey AND i.Signature IN ('Weapon','Armor') GROUP BY 1

SELECT substr(EditorID,1,30) p, COUNT(*) c, MIN(EditorID), MAX(EditorID) FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND json_extract(Data,'`$.AmountProduced')='0' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.WorkbenchKeyword') WB, json_extract(Data,'$.RecipeFilters') F FROM Records WHERE Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject') LIKE '076827:%' OR (Signature='ConstructibleObject' AND json_extract(Data,'$.CreatedObject') LIKE '0403A1:%')

SELECT EditorID, json_extract(Data,'$.MaxRank') mr, json_extract(Data,'$.LevelTierScaledOffset') lt, json_extract(Data,'$.MajorFlags') mf FROM Records WHERE Signature='WeaponModification' AND EditorID LIKE 'mod_DarkStar_Weapon_Mk2_%' LIMIT 4
SELECT Signature, COUNT(*) AS N, SUM(HasScripts) AS Scripted FROM Forms WHERE Signature IN ('PackIn','MoveableStatic') GROUP BY Signature
